contract.invalid_open: The fixed non-matching `/selinos-statu` pathname is bounded-copied, NUL-checked and returns -ENOENT before any server OPEN_PATH IPC.
contract.open: Only exact NUL-terminated `/selinos-state` with AT_FDCWD and zero flags/mode is accepted. Root passes only its two packed scalar words to the isolated server and receives fixed FD 5.
contract.read: Only FD 5, exactly eight bytes and one mapped destination page are accepted; root maps that one user page temporarily, copies one server word, then unmaps/deletes the duplicate cap.
contract.write: Only FD 5, exactly the fixed eight-byte `STATEM0!` payload and one mapped user page are accepted; root copies the word locally and sends no client capability to the server.
contract.lifecycle: The server resets the single volatile word on every fixed open. The probe reads BOOTM0!!, writes STATEM0!, reads it back, closes FD 5, then observes -EBADF for a post-close write.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M7: fixed volatile VFS open/read/write/read-back/close bridge mediated.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: bounded volatile write/read/close lifecycle passed.
SeLinOS ABI M6: deterministic clock_gettime/getrlimit and non-blocking futex mismatch/wake mediated.

not_claimed: persistent data, block I/O, device mapping, virtqueues, IRQs or DMA
arbitrary pathnames, directory traversal, permissions, mounts, metadata or POSIX filesystem semantics
general Linux file descriptors, offsets, partial I/O, multi-page I/O, multi-client sharing, clone inheritance or cleanup semantics
TLS, scheduler, blocking futexes, glibc, dynamic linker, dpkg or apt
